## Data input
```{r}
df <- read_xlsx("xx/metadata.xlsx")  # xx -> change directory accordingly
```

1. Calculate the Ne500-indicator, per species Ne500 = (#pops Ne>=500)/(#total pops), df has information per row on nc-estimates per population and either a 1 or 0 according to whether or not the Ne-value, based on the Ne/Nc-ratio, is above (or equal to) 500 (=1) or below 500 (=0). TL;DR: a row = a population of a species, rows also store info on whether or not Ne per population is >=500 (1 or 0). 
```{r}
# make df with per species information
df_species <- df %>%
  # per species
  group_by(`scientificname`) %>%
  summarise(
  # Nc per species with NA info kept
  Nc_min_2018_species  = if (all(is.na(Nmin_2018_unit2i))) NA_real_ else sum(Nmin_2018_unit2i, na.rm = TRUE),
  Nc_max_2018_species  = if (all(is.na(Nmax_2018_unit2i))) NA_real_ else sum(Nmax_2018_unit2i, na.rm = TRUE),
  Nc_mean_2018_species = if (all(is.na(N_mean_2018))) NA_real_ else sum(N_mean_2018, na.rm = TRUE),
  
  Nc_min_2012_species  = if (all(is.na(Nmin_2012_unit2i))) NA_real_ else sum(Nmin_2012_unit2i, na.rm = TRUE),
  Nc_max_2012_species  = if (all(is.na(Nmax_2012_unit2i))) NA_real_ else sum(Nmax_2012_unit2i, na.rm = TRUE),
  Nc_mean_2012_species = if (all(is.na(N_mean2012))) NA_real_ else sum(N_mean2012, na.rm = TRUE),

  # ST-change
  ST_change_min = if_else(
    !is.na(Nc_min_2018_species) & !is.na(Nc_min_2012_species) & (Nc_min_2018_species + Nc_min_2012_species) > 0,
    ((Nc_min_2018_species - Nc_min_2012_species) /
     (Nc_min_2018_species + Nc_min_2012_species)) * 100,
    NA_real_
  ),
  
  ST_change_max = if_else(
    !is.na(Nc_max_2018_species) & !is.na(Nc_max_2012_species) & (Nc_max_2018_species + Nc_max_2012_species) > 0,
    ((Nc_max_2018_species - Nc_max_2012_species) /
     (Nc_max_2018_species + Nc_max_2012_species)) * 100,
    NA_real_
  ),
  
  ST_change_mean = if_else(
    !is.na(Nc_mean_2018_species) & !is.na(Nc_mean_2012_species) & (Nc_mean_2018_species + Nc_mean_2012_species) > 0,
    ((Nc_mean_2018_species - Nc_mean_2012_species) /
     (Nc_mean_2018_species + Nc_mean_2012_species)) * 100,
    NA_real_
  ),
    # ---- ne500_1_min ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.1; based on minimum Nc-estimates
    # number of populations per species with Ne>=500
    # in this case we calculate how many populations (= rows) per species have a ne >= 500 for ne/nc_min = 0.1
    # value in column ne500_1_2018_min equals 1
    n_ones_1_min  = sum(ne500_1_2018min == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    # number of populations per species with Ne<500
    # in this case we look how many populations (= rows) per species have a ne < 500 for ne/nc_min = 0.1
    # value in column ne500_1_2018_min equals 0
    n_zeros_1_min = sum(ne500_1_2018min == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    # proportion = Ne500-value
    prop_ones_1_min = if_else(
      n_ones_1_min + n_zeros_1_min > 0,
      # formula Ne500 calculation
      n_ones_1_min / (n_ones_1_min + n_zeros_1_min),
      NA_real_
    ),
    # ---- ne500_2_min ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.2; based on minimum Nc-estimates
    n_ones_2_min  = sum(ne500_2_2018min == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_2_min = sum(ne500_2_2018min == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_2_min = if_else(
      n_ones_2_min + n_zeros_2_min > 0,
      n_ones_2_min / (n_ones_2_min + n_zeros_2_min),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ---- ne500_4_min ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.4; based on minimum Nc-estimates
    n_ones_4_min  = sum(ne500_4_2018min == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_4_min = sum(ne500_4_2018min== 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_4_min = if_else(
      n_ones_4_min + n_zeros_4_min > 0,
      n_ones_4_min / (n_ones_4_min + n_zeros_4_min),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ---- ne500_1_max ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.1; based on maximum Nc-estimates
    n_ones_1_max  = sum(ne500_1_2018max == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_1_max = sum(ne500_1_2018max == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_1_max = if_else(
      n_ones_1_max + n_zeros_1_max > 0,
      n_ones_1_max / (n_ones_1_max + n_zeros_1_max),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ---- ne500_2_max ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.2; based on maximum Nc-estimates
    n_ones_2_max  = sum(ne500_2_2018max == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_2_max = sum(ne500_2_2018max == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_2_max = if_else(
      n_ones_2_max + n_zeros_2_max > 0,
      n_ones_2_max / (n_ones_2_max + n_zeros_2_max),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ---- ne500_4_max ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.4; based on maximum Nc-estimates
    n_ones_4_max  = sum(ne500_4_2018max == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_4_max = sum(ne500_4_2018max == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_4_max = if_else(
      n_ones_4_max + n_zeros_4_max > 0,
      n_ones_4_max / (n_ones_4_max + n_zeros_4_max),
      NA_real_
    ),
    # ---- ne500_1_mean ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.1; based on mean Nc-estimates
    n_ones_1_mean  = sum(ne500_1_2018mean == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_1_mean = sum(ne500_1_2018mean == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_1_mean = if_else(
      n_ones_1_mean + n_zeros_1_mean > 0,
      n_ones_1_mean / (n_ones_1_mean + n_zeros_1_mean),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ---- ne500_2_mean ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.2; based on mean Nc-estimates
    n_ones_2_mean  = sum(ne500_2_2018mean == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_2_mean = sum(ne500_2_2018mean == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_2_mean = if_else(
      n_ones_2_mean + n_zeros_2_mean > 0,
      n_ones_2_mean / (n_ones_2_mean + n_zeros_2_mean),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # ---- ne500_4_mean ----
    # Ne/Nc = 0.4; based on mean Nc-estimates
    n_ones_4_mean  = sum(ne500_4_2018mean == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zeros_4_mean = sum(ne500_4_2018mean == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_ones_4_mean = if_else(
      n_ones_4_mean + n_zeros_4_mean > 0,
      n_ones_4_mean / (n_ones_4_mean + n_zeros_4_mean),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# add proportions (= ne500-indicator) and ST-change to df
df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    df_species %>%
      select(`scientificname`, prop_ones_1_min, prop_ones_2_min, prop_ones_4_min, prop_ones_1_max, prop_ones_2_max, prop_ones_4_max, prop_ones_1_mean, prop_ones_2_mean, prop_ones_4_mean, ST_change_min, ST_change_max, ST_change_mean, Nc_min_2018_species, Nc_max_2018_species,Nc_mean_2018_species,Nc_min_2012_species,Nc_max_2012_species,Nc_mean_2012_species),
    by = "scientificname"
  )

# Count number of populations per species
pop_count <- df %>%
  group_by(scientificname) %>%
  summarise(num_populations = n_distinct(popno))
df <- df %>%
  left_join(pop_count, by = "scientificname")  # <- assign back to df!

# save as csv
# write.csv(df, "xx/choose_filename.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
2. Make df more compact and create a df with only one row per species and all the information needed for further analysis
```{r}
# one row per species; info on Ne500 results (stored in "prop_" columns) and red list status
df_unique <- df %>%
  group_by(scientificname) %>%
  summarise(
    # --- NE500 values ---
    prop_ones_1_min  = first(prop_ones_1_min),
    prop_ones_2_min  = first(prop_ones_2_min),
    prop_ones_4_min  = first(prop_ones_4_min),
    prop_ones_1_max  = first(prop_ones_1_max),
    prop_ones_2_max  = first(prop_ones_2_max),
    prop_ones_4_max  = first(prop_ones_4_max),
    prop_ones_1_mean = first(prop_ones_1_mean),
    prop_ones_2_mean = first(prop_ones_2_mean),
    prop_ones_4_mean = first(prop_ones_4_mean),
    # --- red lists ---
    IUCN_redlist = first(IUCN_redlist),
    EU_redlist   = first(EU_redlist),
    # --- red lists simplified ---
    IUCN_redlist2 = first(IUCN_redlist2),
    EU_redlist2   = first(EU_redlist2),
    # --- # populations per species ---
    num_populations = first(num_populations),
    # --- # migratory status per species ---
    migration_status = first(migration_status),
    # --- # ecosystyem per species ---
    ecosystem_cat = first(ecosystem_cat),
    # --- # generation length per species ---
    generation_length = first(generation_length),
    # --- # occurrence per species ---
    occurrence = first(occurrence),
    # --- # GM per species ---
    GM = first(GM), 
    # --- # LT change per species ---
    LT_change = first(Change_index), 
    # --- # ST change per species ---
    ST_change_min = first(ST_change_min),
    ST_change_max = first(ST_change_max),
    ST_change_mean = first(ST_change_mean),
    PM = first(PM),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# save as csv
# in what follows xx indicates your directory
# write.csv(df_unique, "xx/choose_filename.csv", row.names = FALSE) 
```

We now have a df (df_unique) in which all information is found for further analyses. Next step is to visualize the overall distribution of Ne500-values and to test how Ne500 relates to the different species characteristics (number of populations per species, occurrence, generation length, IUCN Red list assessment, EU Red list assessment, migration strategy). First, let's make a new df (so df_unique remains unchanged) to be used for further analyses:
1.Visualization PM
```{r}
# 1.5. Visualisatie van PM verdeling
# Round PM to 2 decimals
df_unique$PM <- round(df_unique$PM, 2)

# Convert PM to factor for categorical plotting
df_unique$PM <- as.factor(df_unique$PM)

# Count species per PM
counts_PM <- df_unique %>% group_by(PM) %>% summarise(count = n())

# Barplot
PM_plot <- ggplot(counts_PM, aes(x = PM, y = count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +  # counts above bars
  labs(x = "PM-indicator", y = "Number of species") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(legend.position="none")
PM_plot

PM_plot_bigger <- ggplot(counts_PM, aes(x = PM, y = count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +  # ADDED: 15% extra space on top
  labs(x = "PM-indicator", y = "Number of species") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

PM_plot_bigger
ggsave(
  filename = "xx/choose_filename.png",
  plot = PM_plot_bigger,
  width = 180,        # mm, standard single column width for most journals
  height = 130,       # mm
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,          # minimum for most journals (some require 600 for line art)
  bg = "white"        # ensures white background
)
```
2. Visualization long-term and short-term change 
2.1 Long-term change (EBBA-based)
```{r}
# Define shared factor levels and colors
levels_trend <- c("Declining","Stable","Increasing","Unknown")

fill_colors <- c(
  "Declining" = "#fdb863",
  "Stable" = "#b2abd2",
  "Increasing" = "#2c7bb6",
  "Unknown" = "grey"
)

# Prepare LT data
df_unique <- df_unique %>%
  mutate(
    Trend_LT = case_when(
      is.na(LT_change) ~ "Unknown",
      LT_change < -5 ~ "Declining",
      LT_change >= -5 & LT_change <= 5 ~ "Stable",
      LT_change > 5 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

trend_percentages_single_LT <- df_unique %>%
  group_by(Trend_LT) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100)

trend_percentages_single_LT$Trend_LT <- factor(trend_percentages_single_LT$Trend_LT, levels = levels_trend)

trend_percentages_single_LT <- trend_percentages_single_LT %>%
  rename(Trend = Trend_LT)

pie_LT_EBBA <- ggplot(trend_percentages_single_LT, aes(x = "", y = Percentage, fill = Trend)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 
  coord_polar(theta = "y") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage,1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5.5) + 
  labs(title = "a. Long-term change") + 
  theme_void() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )

# Prepare ST data
df_unique <- df_unique %>%
  mutate(
    Trend_ST_mean = case_when(
      is.na(ST_change_mean) ~ "Unknown",
      ST_change_mean < -5 ~ "Declining",
      ST_change_mean >= -5 & ST_change_mean <= 5 ~ "Stable",
      ST_change_mean > 5 ~ "Increasing",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

trend_percentages_single_ST_mean <- df_unique %>%
  group_by(Trend_ST_mean) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = (Count / sum(Count)) * 100)

trend_percentages_single_ST_mean$Trend_ST_mean <- factor(trend_percentages_single_ST_mean$Trend_ST_mean, levels = levels_trend)


trend_percentages_single_ST_mean <- trend_percentages_single_ST_mean %>%
  rename(Trend = Trend_ST_mean)

pie_ST <- ggplot(trend_percentages_single_ST_mean, aes(x = "", y = Percentage, fill = Trend)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) + 
  coord_polar(theta = "y") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percentage,1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5.5) + 
  labs(title = "b. Short-term change") + 
  theme_void() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )

# Combine LT and ST pies with shared legend and global title
combined_pies <- (pie_LT_EBBA | pie_ST) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &  
  theme(legend.position = "right")


combined_pies2 <- (pie_LT_EBBA | pie_ST) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &  
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),                
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")                       
  )

combined_pies2
#ggsave("choose_filename.png", combined_pies, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
#write.csv(df_unique, "xx/choose_filename.csv", row.names = FALSE)
ggsave(
  filename = "xx/suppfig1.png",
  plot = combined_pies2,
  width = 240,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
3. Visualization overall distribution of Ne500-values in the dataset. 
3.1. Create new dfs especially for visualization and lm analyses 
```{r}
df_relations <- df_unique

# df to long-format
df_relations_long <- df_relations %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("prop_ones"),
    names_to = "measure",   # e.g. "prop_ones_1_max"
    values_to = "Ne500"
  ) %>%
  separate(
    measure,
    into = c(NA, NA, "scenario", "Nc-estimate"),  
    sep = "_",
    remove = TRUE                             # e.g. column "prop_ones_1_max" into columns NA, NA, "1" and "max"
  ) %>%
  mutate(IUCN_redlist = factor(
      IUCN_redlist,
      levels = c("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT", "LC"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ), 
    EU_redlist = factor(
      EU_redlist,
      levels = c("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT", "LC"),   
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    # simplified redlist cats
    IUCN_redlist2 = factor(
      IUCN_redlist2,
      levels = c("Threatened", "Not Threatened"),
      ordered = TRUE
    ), 
    EU_redlist2 = factor(
      EU_redlist2,
      levels = c("Threatened", "Not Threatened"),   
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    migration_status = factor(
      migration_status),
    ecosystem_cat = factor(
      ecosystem_cat),
    scenario = factor(scenario)  # scenario as factor for interactions
  )

# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "mean"
df_relations_long_mean <- df_relations_long %>%
  filter(`Nc-estimate` == "mean")

# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "min"
df_relations_long_min <- df_relations_long %>%
  filter(`Nc-estimate` == "min")

# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "max"
df_relations_long_max <- df_relations_long %>%
  filter(`Nc-estimate` == "max")

# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "mean" and scenario == "2"
df_relations_long_mean_2 <- df_relations_long_mean %>%
  filter(scenario == "2")
# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "mean" and scenario == "4"
df_relations_long_mean_4 <- df_relations_long_mean %>%
  filter(scenario == "4")
# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "mean" and scenario == "1"
df_relations_long_mean_1 <- df_relations_long_mean %>%
  filter(scenario == "1")

# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "min" and scenario == "2"
df_relations_long_min_2 <- df_relations_long_min %>%
  filter(scenario == "2")
# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "min" and scenario == "4"
df_relations_long_min_4 <- df_relations_long_min %>%
  filter(scenario == "4")
# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "min" and scenario == "1"
df_relations_long_min_1 <- df_relations_long_min %>%
  filter(scenario == "1")

# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "max" and scenario == "2"
df_relations_long_max_2 <- df_relations_long_max %>%
  filter(scenario == "2")
# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "max" and scenario == "4"
df_relations_long_max_4 <- df_relations_long_max %>%
  filter(scenario == "4")
# df with only`Nc-estimate` == "max" and scenario == "1"
df_relations_long_max_1 <- df_relations_long_max %>%
  filter(scenario == "1")
```
3.2. Calculate counts for the categorical explanatory variables and create labels with counts and for each ratio
We want to calculate how many species are found for each category of each of the categorical variables. These counts are used for plotting of figures. 

```{r}
# counts per categorical variable
counts_migration<- df_relations %>%
  group_by(migration_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
counts_ecosystem<- df_relations %>%
  group_by(ecosystem_cat) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
counts_EU_redlist<- df_relations %>%
  group_by(EU_redlist) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
counts_IUCN_redlist<- df_relations %>%
  group_by(IUCN_redlist) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
counts_EU_redlist2<- df_relations %>%
  group_by(EU_redlist2) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
counts_IUCN_redlist2<- df_relations %>%
  group_by(IUCN_redlist2) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# create labels with counts
labels_with_counts_migr <- counts_migration %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(migration_status, " (n = ", n, ")")) %>%
  select(migration_status, label)
labels_with_counts_ecosys <- counts_ecosystem %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(ecosystem_cat, " (n = ", n, ")")) %>%
  select(ecosystem_cat, label)
labels_with_counts_EU_RL <- counts_EU_redlist %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(EU_redlist, " (n = ", n, ")")) %>%
  select(EU_redlist, label)
labels_with_counts_IUCN_RL <- counts_IUCN_redlist %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(IUCN_redlist, " (n = ", n, ")")) %>%
  select(IUCN_redlist, label)
labels_with_counts_EU_RL2 <- counts_EU_redlist2 %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(EU_redlist2, " (n = ", n, ")")) %>%
  select(EU_redlist2, label)
labels_with_counts_IUCN_RL2 <- counts_IUCN_redlist2 %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(IUCN_redlist2, " (n = ", n, ")")) %>%
  select(IUCN_redlist2, label)

# create scenario (=Ne/Nc-ratio) labels
scenario_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Ne/Nc = 0.1",
  "2" = "Ne/Nc = 0.2",
  "4" = "Ne/Nc = 0.4"
)
```

3.4. create violinplots showing the overall distributions
```{r}
# general overview ne500 (all NC-estimates)
```

4. Do the correlation analyses with NE500 being the response variable and species specific traits as explanatory variables
```{r}
#---------------------------------------- 
# Settings 
#----------------------------------------
vars <- c("num_populations", 
          "EU_redlist",
          "migration_status", 
          "generation_length", 
          "occurrence", 
          "LT_change",
          "ST_change_mean")

# Identification of categorical vars
categorical_vars <- c("EU_redlist", 
                      "migration_status")

# List to save vars
results_list <- list()

plot_emmeans_facet <- function(em, varname, response_name){
  em_df <- as.data.frame(em)
  
  ggplot(em_df, aes_string(x = varname, y = "emmean")) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ scenario,
               labeller = labeller(scenario = scenario_labels))+
    labs(
      title = paste("Estimated marginal means of", response_name),
      subtitle = paste("by", varname, "per scenario"),
      y = paste(response_name, "(estimated)"),
      x = varname
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

get_n_by_group <- function(data, var){
  data %>%
    group_by(.data[[var]], scenario) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(level = 1)
} 

```
4.1 Now follows the script to loop the correlation analyses between the different variables, NE500 is always the response variable. 
4.2 this is the correct script to loop the correlation analyses 
```{r}
cont_plots <- list()
emmeans_plots <- list()
cont_plots_s2 <- list()

pretty_labels <- c(
  "num_populations" = "a. Number of populations",
  "generation_length" = "b. Generation length",
  "occurrence" = "c. Occurrence",
  "LT_change" = "d. LT-change",
  "ST_change_mean" = "e. ST-change (mean Nc)", 
  "IUCN_redlist" = "IUCN Red List", 
  "EU_redlist" = "a. EU Red List", 
  "migration_status" = "b. Migration status", 
  "IUCN_redlist2" = "IUCN Red List (simplified categories)", 
  "EU_redlist2" = "EU Red List (simplified categories)")

for(v in vars){
  cat("\n==================== Variable:", v, "vs Ne500 ====================\n")
  
  formula_text <- paste0("Ne500 ~ (", v, ") * scenario + (1 | scientificname)")
  model <- lmer(as.formula(formula_text), data=df_relations_long_mean)
  
  results_list[[paste0(v, "_Ne500")]] <- list(model = model)
  
  print(summary(model))
  
  plot(residuals(model), main=paste("Residuals:", v))
  qqnorm(residuals(model), main=paste("Q-Q plot:", v))
  qqline(residuals(model))
  
  if(v %in% categorical_vars){
    cat("\n--- Post-hoc Tukey comparisons for", v, "---\n")
    
    em <- emmeans(model, specs = c(v, "scenario"))
    print(em)
    print(pairs(em, by = "scenario", adjust = "tukey"))
    
    # extract compact letter display for significance stars
    sig_letters <- multcomp::cld(em, by = "scenario", adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rename(level = !!v) %>%
      mutate(
        level = as.character(level),
        scenario = as.character(scenario),
        .group = trimws(.group)
      )

    n_df <- get_n_by_group(df_relations_long_mean, v)
    
    em_df <- as.data.frame(em) %>%
      rename(level = !!v) %>%
      mutate(
        level = as.character(level),
        scenario = as.character(scenario)
      )
    
    n_df <- n_df %>%
      mutate(
        level = as.character(level),
        scenario = as.character(scenario)
      )
    
    em_df <- left_join(em_df, n_df, by = c("level", "scenario"))
    em_df <- em_df %>%
      mutate(
        lower.CL = ifelse(n > 1, lower.CL, NA),
        upper.CL = ifelse(n > 1, upper.CL, NA)
      )

    # 1. compile lables with n
    em_df <- em_df %>%
      mutate(label = paste0(level, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))

    # 2. Change underscores into space in the lables
    em_df <- em_df %>%
      mutate(label = gsub("_", " ", label))

    # 3. change to factor
    if(v %in% c("IUCN_redlist", "EU_redlist", "IUCN_redlist2", "EU_redlist2")){
      ordered_levels <- c("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT", "LC")
      
      expected_levels <- paste0(ordered_levels, "\n(n = ", n_df$n[match(ordered_levels, n_df$level)], ")")
      expected_levels <- gsub("_", " ", expected_levels)
      
      em_df <- em_df %>%
        mutate(
          level = factor(level, levels = ordered_levels),
          label = factor(label, levels = expected_levels)
        )
    } else {
      orig_levels <- levels(df_relations_long_mean[[v]])
      
      expected_levels <- paste0(orig_levels, "\n(n = ", n_df$n[match(orig_levels, n_df$level)], ")")
      expected_levels <- gsub("_", " ", expected_levels)
      
      em_df <- em_df %>%
        mutate(
          label = factor(label, levels = expected_levels)
        )
    }

    # join significance letters into em_df
    em_df <- left_join(em_df, sig_letters %>% dplyr::select(level, scenario, .group),
                       by = c("level", "scenario"))

    # level no underscores for colour palette 
    em_df <- em_df %>% 
      mutate(level = gsub("_", " ", level))

    # Red list with colours, other black
    if(v %in% c("IUCN_redlist", "EU_redlist", "IUCN_redlist2", "EU_redlist2")) {
      p <- ggplot(em_df, aes(x = label, y = emmean, colour = level))
    } else {
      p <- ggplot(em_df, aes(x = label, y = emmean))
    }

    p <- p +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_text(aes(y = upper.CL + 0.15, label = .group), na.rm = TRUE, size = 5, colour = "black") +
      facet_wrap(~ scenario, labeller = labeller(scenario = scenario_labels)) +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = "EMMs of proportion Ne≥500",
        title = ifelse(v %in% names(pretty_labels), pretty_labels[v], v)
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        # AANGEPAST: angle = 45, hjust = 1 & vjust = 1 voorkomt overlap van x-as labels
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none" # Legenda verborgen omdat x-as categorieën al benoemt
      )
    
    # NIEUW: Voeg het kleurenpalet toe voor Red List variabelen
    if(v %in% c("IUCN_redlist", "EU_redlist")){
      p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = iucn_colors)
    } else if(v %in% c("IUCN_redlist2", "EU_redlist2")){
      p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = simplified_colours)
    }

    emmeans_plots[[v]] <- p
    print(p)
    
    results_list[[v]]$emmeans <- em
    results_list[[v]]$emmeans_plot <- p
    results_list[[v]]$n_per_group <- n_df
  }

  if(!(v %in% categorical_vars)){
    
    f_lin <- paste0("Ne500 ~ ", v, " * scenario + (1 | scientificname)")
    m_lin <- lmer(as.formula(f_lin), data = df_relations_long_mean, REML = FALSE)
    
    f_quad <- paste0("Ne500 ~ poly(", v, ", 2, raw = TRUE) * scenario + (1 | scientificname)")
    m_quad <- lmer(as.formula(f_quad), data = df_relations_long_mean, REML = FALSE)
    
    aic_tab <- AIC(m_lin, m_quad)
    print(aic_tab)
    
    if(aic_tab$AIC[2] + 2 < aic_tab$AIC[1]){
      best_model <- m_quad
      model_type <- "quadratic"
      cat("→ Selected QUADRATIC model for", v, "\n")
    } else {
      best_model <- m_lin
      model_type <- "linear"
      cat("→ Selected LINEAR model for", v, "\n")
    }
    
    print(summary(best_model))
    
    x_range <- range(df_relations_long_mean[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)

    pred <- ggpredict(best_model, terms = c(paste0(v, " [all]"), "scenario"))
    
    p_pred <- ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = group, fill = group)) +
      geom_line(size = 1) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Model-based predictions of Ne500"),
        subtitle = paste("(", model_type, "effect )"),
        x = ifelse(v %in% names(pretty_labels), pretty_labels[v], v),  
        y = "Predicted proportion Ne≥500",
        colour = "Ratio",
        fill = "Ratio"
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("#966fd6","#F0E442","#0072B2"), labels = scenario_labels) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#966fd6","#F0E442","#0072B2"), labels = scenario_labels) +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
      )
    cont_plots[[v]] <- p_pred
    
    # extra plot for scenario 2 only
    pred_s2 <- pred %>% filter(group == "2")
    
    p_pred_s2 <- ggplot(pred_s2, aes(x = x, y = predicted)) +
      geom_line(size = 1, colour = "#F0E442") +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, fill = "#F0E442") +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Model-based predictions of Ne500"),
        subtitle = paste("(", model_type, "effect ) - Ne/Nc = 0,2"),
        x = ifelse(v %in% names(pretty_labels), pretty_labels[v], v),
        y = "Predicted proportion Ne≥500"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
      )
    cont_plots_s2[[v]] <- p_pred_s2
    print(p_pred_s2)
    print(p_pred)
    
    results_list[[paste0(v, "_Ne500")]] <- list(
      model = best_model,
      model_type = model_type,
      AIC = aic_tab,
      prediction_plot = p_pred
    )
  }
}

cont_combined <- wrap_plots(cont_plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = rep(1, ceiling(length(cont_plots)/2)), 
    guides = "collect",
    axis_titles = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), # Titel van de legende: 14 + bold
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),                 # Categorieën in de legende: 14
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),   # Verzamelde astitels: 16 + bold
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),                   # As-labels (x en y): 14
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),                  # Facet headers (indien aanwezig): 14
    plot.title = element_blank(),                          # Subplot titels (verborgen)
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()                        # Subplot subtitels (verborgen)
  )

print(cont_combined)

# combined plot for scenario 2 only
cont_combined_s2 <- wrap_plots(cont_plots_s2, ncol = 2) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = rep(1, ceiling(length(cont_plots_s2)/2)),
    axis_titles = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(), plot.subtitle = element_blank())

cont_combined_s2 <- cont_combined_s2 +
  plot_annotation(title = "Model-based predictions of proportion Ne≥500 (Ne/Nc = 0,2)")

print(cont_combined_s2)

emmeans_combined <- wrap_plots(emmeans_plots, ncol = 1) +

    heights = rep(1, ceiling(length(emmeans_plots))),

  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # Geen legende meer

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14) 
  ) 

print(emmeans_combined)
```

```{r}
# GM vs IUCN Red List
cat("Fisher's exact test: GM vs IUCN Red List\n")
tbl_IUCN <- table(df_relations_long_mean$GM, df_relations_long_mean$IUCN_redlist)

fisher_IUCN <- fisher.test(tbl_IUCN)

# Effect size: Cramér's V
cat("\nEffect size (Cramér's V): GM vs IUCN Red List\n")
cramers_v_IUCN <- rcompanion::cramerV(tbl_IUCN, bias.correct = TRUE)
print(cramers_v_IUCN)

# GM vs EU Red List
cat("\nFisher's exact test: GM vs EU Red List\n")

print(tbl_EU)
fisher_EU <- fisher.test(tbl_EU)
print(fisher_EU)

# Effect size: Cramér's V
cat("\nEffect size (Cramér's V): GM vs EU Red List\n")
cramers_v_EU <- rcompanion::cramerV(tbl_EU, bias.correct = TRUE)
print(cramers_v_EU)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)

# All combinations of x (min, mean, max) and y (1, 2, 4)
combos <- expand.grid(
  x = c("min", "mean", "max"),
  y = c(1, 2, 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

summary_list <- pmap(combos, function(x, y) {
  df_name <- paste0("df_relations_long_", x, "_", y)
  
  # Skip gracefully if the object doesn't exist
  if (!exists(df_name)) {
    warning(paste("Object not found:", df_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(PM_num = as.numeric(as.character(PM))) %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        c(Ne500, PM_num),
        list(
          mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          se     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.x))),
          median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        ),
        .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(estimate = x, ratio = y, .before = 1)
})

# Combine into one dataframe, dropping any NULLs from missing objects
summary_stats_all <- bind_rows(summary_list)

summary_stats_all
``` 

```{r}
# 1. Kruskal-Wallis Rank Sum Test (Non-parametric)
# Recommended if PM_num does not meet the assumptions of normality and homogeneity of variances
cat("\n==================== Kruskal-Wallis Test ====================\n")
cat("Testing: PM_num vs EU_redlist\n\n")
kw_test_PM_EU <- kruskal.test(PM_num ~ EU_redlist, data = df_relations_long_mean_2)
print(kw_test_PM_EU)

# 2. One-Way ANOVA (Parametric)
# Useful if the data is relatively normally distributed across groups
cat("\n==================== One-Way ANOVA ====================\n")
cat("Testing: PM_num vs EU_redlist\n\n")
anova_PM_EU <- aov(PM_num ~ EU_redlist, data = df_relations_long_mean_2)
print(summary(anova_PM_EU))
```
